title: Content OS Embedded Captions workflow state

mode.description: Caption mode. standard=rail+embed climax; cinematic=pure embed; theme=themed constitution.

identity.description: Picked identity from the catalog (DNA registry or theme).

vo_mode.description: Captions derived from footage speech via transcription. Only 'transcribed' valid. The footage carries its own VO.

has_script.description: No SCRIPT.md authored — transcript is derived from footage, not authored.

footage.description: This workflow takes existing talking-head footage. footage:true is valid here (unlike motion-graphics).

graded_footage.description: If true = graded-footage violation (never grade/recolor the footage).

embed_all.description: If true = embed-overuse violation (rail-first; embedding every word is the common mistake).

rail_mode.description: rail=rail track present (default); none=no rail (embed-overuse if standard/cinematic without rail).

burned_in_captions.description: If true, source already has burned-in captions — decision gate should refuse.

transcript_source.description: Transcription engine. offline=whisper.cpp (default); remote=WhisperX opt-in auth-gated.

matte_source.description: Matting engine. offline=ffmpeg bg-removal (default); remote opt-in auth-gated.
